name: Firebase Firestore
description: Inject a configured Firestore instance into FirestoreDocuments<Row>.

cost.note: Provider charges and quotas depend on your account; consult the official pricing page.

usage: Inject a configured Firestore instance into FirestoreDocuments<Row>. Configure FirebaseCore once before constructing it. Use authenticated per-user paths and restrictive Firestore rules, tested with the emulator; a client wrapper does not deploy or prove security rules. Use synthetic in-memory services in previews.
statusNote: Built into a minimal app with Xcode 27.0 (27A266a) on 2026-10-09.
